== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-289o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">タトゥイーンを占領している場合、ここにいる自分の宇宙船１隻につき、タトゥイーンの位置カード上での戦闘時で、合計戦力に＋１。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">タトゥイーンを占領している場合、ここにいる自分の宇宙船１隻につき、タトゥイーンの位置カード上での戦闘時で、合計戦力に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed on this card.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Tatooine.

'''Light Side:''' If you occupy Tatooine, add 1 to total power in battles at Tatooine sites for each of your starships here.

'''Dark Side:''' If you occupy Tatooine, add 1 to total power in battles at Tatooine sites for each of your starships here.

* '''Uniqueness:''' Unique (one marker)
* '''Subtype:''' System (planet)
* '''Light Force icons:''' 1
* '''Dark Force icons:''' 2
* '''Parsec:''' 7<ref name="jp-face" />
